messages:
tara-docs: Heads-upI opened a PR to merge the Dedicated -> Autoscale migration guide into the main provisioning docs: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/501. Need a couple of tiny infra snippets and a clarification on SLA language before we can merge.

Key asks:
- minimal k8s pod annotation example (how tenants map to reserved pools during transition)
- tiny Terraform (inline resource) + Python SDK example for create_autoscale_policy
- explicit wording about eviction vs isolation for SLA (legal wants explicit exclusions)

Can @sam-eng take the snippets and @oliver-infra the k8s idioms? @maria-ml can we mention perf caveats? Jenna, can you polish SLA bullets?

sam-eng: on it. I'll keep the TF inline and the Python one-liner. prefer showing burst_capacity field so folks see the option.

oliver-infra: annotated pod example and an OSS note: in managed installs we create a PriorityClass "redwood-dedicated"; for OSS recommend using "high-priority" or creating your own. Also, the reserved binding uses `redwood/reserved=true` annotation in our operator.

oliver-infra: k8s example (trimmed):

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: llm-worker-sample
  annotations:
    redwood/tenant-id: "tenant-42"
    redwood/reserved: "true"
spec:
  priorityClassName: redwood-dedicated  # OSS: use high-priority or create class
  containers:
    - name: runtime
      image: redwood/llm-runtime:stable
      resources:
        limits:
          nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```

maria-ml: add a perf note: "Cold starts when autoscaling new replicas may add ~300-600ms due to KV-cache warmup depending on model and sequence length. Consider min_replicas>0 or prewarm hooks for strict p99 latency." I'll add a short table of which model variants persist KV-cache to the PR comments.

tara-docs: good, add that sentence under "Performance considerations". Jenna, legal wants explicit exclusion bullet points for SLA; Chris do you want to draft or should Jenna?

chris-sre: I'll list SRE-known exemptions: cloud provider preemption/maintenance, user misconfiguration (missing tenant/reserved annotation), and operator upgrade drain. Eviction due to capacity pressure within an under-provisioned ReservedPool is covered by SLA if contract limits aren't exceeded; if tenant requested >contracted capacity it's exempt.

jenna-techwriter: drafting SLA text now. Proposed paragraph: "Redwood Dedicated aims to maintain availability for bound ReservedPools per the SLA. Evictions caused by platform maintenance, cloud preemption events, operator-initiated node drains, or tenant misconfiguration (e.g., missing `redwood/reserved` annotation) are excluded from uptime credits. Isolation guarantees apply only when a tenant is correctly bound to a ReservedPool and usage stays within contractual limits." Thoughts?

sam-eng: looks good. here's the TF example (very short inline):

```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_autoscale_policy" "example" {
  tenant_id    = "tenant-42"
  min_replicas = 1
  max_replicas = 6
  cpu_target   = 65
  burst_policy {
    enabled        = true
    burst_capacity = 1
  }
}
```

sam-eng: Python quick snippet (one-liner style):

```py
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
policy = client.create_autoscale_policy(tenant_id="tenant-42", min_replicas=1, max_replicas=6, cpu_target=65, burst_capacity=1)
print(policy.id)
```

tara-docs: please also add a link to the SDK reference for create_autoscale_policy (I put a TODO). Jenna can you swap that in after drafting SLA bullets?

docs-bot: CI checks started: spellcheck passed; linkcheck failed (1 broken link: /docs/legacy/terraform-module).

jenna-techwriter: I removed the legacy link and replaced it with the new inline TF example reference. Added the SLA bullet points and the OSS note about priorityClass. Pushed changes to the branch.

docs-bot: linkcheck re-run requested by jenna-techwriter. queued.

maria-ml: uploaded a tiny matrix in PR comments listing models + KV persistence: gpt-x-small: no, gpt-x-medium: partial, gpt-x-large: yes. will also note typical warmup ranges per model.

sam-eng: updated the PR with the TF + Python examples and shortened the k8s snippet per OSS note.

chris-sre: SRE reviewed the SLA bullets and added an example showing "Exempt: spot preemption by cloud provider". LGTM from SRE.

tara-docs: thanks everyone. plan: wait for green linkcheck, then merge. If linkcheck passes and nothing else pops up, I'll merge in ~1h. :shipit:
